items.note: A 12-week quasi-experiment with 240 pre-service teachers that uses generative-AI instructional design tools and reports gains in fluency, flexibility, originality, elaboration, and design quality; the abstract does not describe the comparison group and reports very large effects (d=0.94-1.28), so check the design in the full text.

CHI system paper on ProductMeta, a multimodal-LLM tool for metaphorical product design ideation; user studies report more diverse and relevant ideas from novice designers, but the abstract names no comparison condition or sample size (it may be system_paper_no_comparison).
30 participants did a conceptual design task in human-ChatGPT groups or human-human groups (AI versus human partner); design outputs did not differ, LLM groups finished faster; below 50 participants.

Dyads worked with an AI whose viewpoint divergence was manipulated (high versus low) on scientific and everyday creativity tasks, with idea novelty and usefulness scored and fNIRS hyperscanning; abstract is in Chinese and states no sample size or assignment, while the search notes report 89 dyads (178 people) randomly assigned; ChinaXiv preprint exists.
